ea23332e988d1570.title: Jupiter Symphony - What Makes It Great
ea23332e988d1570.desc: In one of music's most astonishing feats, Mozart wrote his final three symphonies in just six weeks during the summer of 1788. Why he wrote them, or whether he ever heard them performed, remains a mystery, but the final work in the trilogy remains one of the most iconic pieces ever written. Join Rob Kapilow and the Cal State Fullerton Orchestra to explore the music and mystery behind the iconic Jupiter Symphony, one of Mozart's and the world's greatest masterpieces.

ea4f604896e8810c.desc: Montserrat, a talented sound editor in 1990s Mexico City, is secretly in love with her best friend, faded soap star Tristán. When they meet cursed horror director Abel Urueta, he convinces them to help complete a mysterious unfinished film involving occult magic and Nazi sorcery. But as they investigate, Montserrat is haunted by a dark presence and Tristán sees his dead ex-girlfriend. Together, they must uncover the film’s supernatural secrets before the curse consumes them.
